The 10 PM reset, faith edition. A Christian night routine for this winter. 🌧️

5 steps: put the day down, phone off the pillow, read one chapter, write one line, then check what stuck. Not a law. Just a better end to your day than one more hour of scrolling.

Philippians 4:13 isn't about winning the game. 🏈

Paul wrote it in bonds, in a thank-you note to a church that had sent him help. The verse right before says he learned to be content “both to be full and to be hungry.” So “all things” includes the bad seasons too. It's a better promise than a win.

Did you already know the context? Yes or no 👇
